  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(random,random,r...); ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(70,45,20,${...})`; ctx.fill();

}

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x07191f);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x07191f, 10, 22);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      42,

      0.1,
      50
    );

    const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.25, 0);

    let currentTheta = 0.72;
    let currentPhi = 1.08;
    let currentRadius = 8.4;

    let desiredTheta = currentTheta;
    let desiredPhi = currentPhi;
    let desiredRadius = currentRadius;

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x91d9d1, 0x24170d, 1.65));

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffdfb3, 3.2);
    keyLight.position.set(4.5, 7, 5.5);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -5;

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x55bdc8, 1.45);
    fillLight.position.set(-5, 3, 2);

    const rimLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xff7a38, 22, 12, 2);
    rimLight.position.set(0, 3.2, -4);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural sponge texture
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createSpongeTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 512;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 512, 512);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#e2c287");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.5, "#cda868");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#b98b50");

      context.fillStyle = gradient;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

      // Random porous surface.
      for (let i = 0; i < 1450; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 512;
        const y = Math.random() * 512;
        const radius = 1.5 + Math.random() * 8.5;
        const darkness = 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.22;

        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fillStyle = `rgba(65, 39, 16, ${darkness})`;
        context.fill();

        // Small highlights make the pores read as indentations.
        const highlightX = x - radius * 0.35;
        const highlightY = y - radius * 0.35;
        const highlightRadius = radius * 0.28;

        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(highlightX, highlightY, highlightRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 231, 181, 0.18)";
        context.fill();
      }

      // Fine organic texture.
      for (let i = 0; i < 2200; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 512;
        const y = Math.random() * 512;
        const radius = 0.4 + Math.random() * 1.6;

        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fillStyle =
          Math.random() > 0.5
            ? "rgba(255, 235, 194, 0.10)"
            : "rgba(67, 38, 15, 0.08)";
        context.fill();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(2.4, 1.25);
      texture.anisotropy = Math.min(8, renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy());

      return texture;
    }

    const spongeColorTexture = createSpongeTexture();
    const spongeBumpTexture = spongeColorTexture.clone();
    spongeBumpTexture.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
    spongeBumpTexture.needsUpdate = true;

    const spongeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      map: spongeColorTexture,
      bumpMap: spongeBumpTexture,
      bumpScale: 0.065,
      roughness: 0.96,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const rimMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xd5b174,
      map: spongeColorTexture,
      bumpMap: spongeBumpTexture,
      bumpScale: 0.05,
      roughness: 0.93
    });

    const innerSpongeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x76552f,
      roughness: 1,
      side: THREE.BackSide
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Barrel sponge
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const sponge = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(sponge);

    const bodyHeight = 1.9;
    const bodyTop = 2.05;
    const bodyBottom = 0.15;

    // Hollow, slightly tapered barrel.
    const spongeBody = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.35, 2.05, bodyHeight, 72, 1, true),
      spongeMaterial
    );
    spongeBody.position.y = (bodyTop + bodyBottom) / 2;
    spongeBody.castShadow = true;
    spongeBody.receiveShadow = true;
    sponge.add(spongeBody);

    // Dark inner wall, visible through the open top.
    const innerWall = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.2, 1.88, bodyHeight - 0.08, 72, 1, true),
      innerSpongeMaterial
    );
    innerWall.position.y = (bodyTop + bodyBottom) / 2;
    innerWall.receiveShadow = true;
    sponge.add(innerWall);

    // Thick rounded rim.
    const rim = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(2.28, 0.17, 14, 80),
      rimMaterial
    );
    rim.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    rim.position.y = bodyTop;
    rim.castShadow = true;
    rim.receiveShadow = true;
    sponge.add(rim);

    // Dark bottom of the barrel.
    const spongeBottom = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.06, 2.06, 0.12, 72),
      spongeMaterial
    );
    spongeBottom.position.y = 0.22;
    spongeBottom.castShadow = true;
    spongeBottom.receiveShadow = true;
    sponge.add(spongeBottom);

    // Inner floor.
    const innerFloor = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(2.17, 72),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x5c4026,
        roughness: 1,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      })
    );
    innerFloor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    innerFloor.position.y = bodyTop - 0.075;
    sponge.add(innerFloor);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Brittle star
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const star = new THREE.Group();
    star.rotation.y = -0.12;
    scene.add(star);

    const armMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xb8682f,
      roughness: 0.72,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const jointMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x71351d,
      roughness: 0.8
    });

    const discShape = new THREE.Shape();
    const discSegments = 32;

    // Irregular central disc.
    for (let i = 0; i <= discSegments; i++) {
      const angle = (i / discSegments) * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = i % 2 === 0 ? 0.64 : 0.49;
      const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
      const y = Math.sin(angle) * radius;

      if (i === 0) {
        discShape.moveTo(x, y);
      } else {
        discShape.lineTo(x, y);
      }
    }
    discShape.closePath();

    const discGeometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(discShape, {
      depth: 0.075,
      bevelEnabled: true,
      bevelSegments: 2,
      bevelSize: 0.025,
      bevelThickness: 0.02
    });
    discGeometry.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);

    const centralDisc = new THREE.Mesh(discGeometry, armMaterial);
    centralDisc.position.y = 2.185;
    centralDisc.castShadow = true;
    centralDisc.receiveShadow = true;
    star.add(centralDisc);

    // Small raised center.
    const centralBoss = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.14, 16, 10),
      armMaterial
    );
    centralBoss.scale.y = 0.48;
    centralBoss.position.y = 2.29;
    centralBoss.castShadow = true;
    star.add(centralBoss);

    // Tiny peripheral nodules give the disc a brittle-star texture.
    const noduleGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.043, 8, 6);
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 18) * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = 0.555;
      const nodule = new THREE.Mesh(noduleGeometry, armMaterial);
      nodule.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        2.265,
        Math.sin(angle) * radius
      );
      nodule.scale.y = 0.45;
      nodule.castShadow = true;
      star.add(nodule);
    }

    /**
     * Creates one long, jointed arm following a curved path.
     * Each segment is a tapered cylinder with a darker joint at its end.
     */
    function createArm(angle, sway) {
      const points = [
        { radius: 0.22, y: 2.285 },
        { radius: 0.76, y: 2.55 },
        { radius: 1.45, y: 2.39 },
        { radius: 2.43, y: 1.98 },
        { radius: 2.55, y: 1.43 },
        { radius: 2.46, y: 0.89 },
        { radius: 2.31, y: 0.47 },
        { radius: 2.19, y: 0.28 }
      ];

      const pathPoints = points.map((point, index) => {
        const radial = point.radius + sway * (
          [0.0, 0.16, 0.24, 0.18, 0.12, 0.1, 0.12, 0.1]
        )[index];

        return new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * radial,
          point.y,
          Math.sin(angle) * radial
        );
      });

      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
        pathPoints,
        false,
        "catmullrom",
        0.5
      );

      const samples = curve.getPoints(17);
      const segmentCount = samples.length - 1;

      for (let i = 0; i < segmentCount; i++) {
        const start = samples[i];
        const end = samples[i + 1];

        const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
        const length = direction.length();
        const startRadius = 0.185 * Math.pow(1 - i / segmentCount, 0.78);
        const endRadius = 0.185 * Math.pow(1 - (i + 1) / segmentCount, 0.78);

        const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
          endRadius,
          startRadius,
          length,
          8,
          1,
          false
        );

        const segment = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, armMaterial);
        segment.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        segment.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
          direction.normalize()
        );
        segment.castShadow = true;
        segment.receiveShadow = true;
        star.add(segment);
      }

      // Visible beads mark the flexible joints.
      for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) {
        const previousRadius = 0.185 * Math.pow(1 - (i - 1) / segmentCount, 0.78);
        const jointRadius = Math.max(0.052, previousRadius * 0.88);

        const joint = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.SphereGeometry(jointRadius, 10, 7),
          armMaterial
        );
        joint.position.copy(samples[i]);
        joint.castShadow = true;
        star.add(joint);

        const center = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.SphereGeometry(jointRadius * 0.39, 8, 6),
          jointMaterial
        );
        center.position.copy(samples[i]);
        star.add(center);
      }

      // Rounded terminal tip.
      const tipRadius = 0.185 * Math.pow(1 - segmentCount / segmentCount, 0.78);
      const tip = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(tipRadius * 0.9, 10, 7),
        armMaterial
      );
      tip.position.copy(samples[samples.length - 1]);
      tip.castShadow = true;
      star.add(tip);
    }

    // Five arms, each extending at a different angle and curling differently.
    const armDefinitions = [
      { angle: 0.12, sway: 0.00 },
      { angle: 1.37, sway: 0.18 },
      { angle: 2.62, sway: -0.08 },
      { angle: 0.86, sway: 0.24 },
      { angle: 2.09, sway: -0.14 }
    ];

    armDefinitions.forEach((definition) => {
      createArm(definition.angle, definition.sway);
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Floor and background
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x07171c,
        roughness: 0.92,
        metalness: 0.05
      })
    );
    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    floor.position.y = 0;
    floor.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(floor);

    // A subtle circular pool of light on the floor adds depth.
    const floorGlow = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(4.5, 64),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0x0c292d,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.55,
        depthWrite: false
      })
    );
    floorGlow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    floorGlow.position.y = 0.012;
    scene.add(floorGlow);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom camera controls
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    let dragging = false;
    let previousX = 0;
    let previousY = 0;

    const canvas = renderer.domElement;

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      dragging = true;
      previousX = event.clientX;
      previousY = event.clientY;
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!dragging) return;

      const deltaX = event.clientX - previousX;
      const deltaY = event.clientY - previousY;

      previousX = event.clientX;
      previousY = event.clientY;

      desiredTheta -= deltaX * 0.006;
      desiredPhi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        desiredPhi - deltaY * 0.005,
        0.35,
        1.46
      );
    });

    function endDrag(event) {
      dragging = false;
      if (canvas.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
        canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      }
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        desiredRadius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          desiredRadius * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          4.6,
          13
        );
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    function resetCamera() {
      desiredTheta = 0.72;
      desiredPhi = 1.08;
      desiredRadius = 8.4;
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", resetCamera);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Resize and animation
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    function animate() {
      const delta = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);
      const smoothing = 1 - Math.exp(-8 * delta);

      currentTheta += (desiredTheta - currentTheta) * smoothing;
      currentPhi += (desiredPhi - currentPhi) * smoothing;
      currentRadius += (desiredRadius - currentRadius) * smoothing;

      const sinPhi = Math.sin(currentPhi);

      camera.position.set(
        currentRadius * sinPhi * Math.sin(currentTheta),
        currentRadius * Math.cos(currentPhi),
        currentRadius * sinPhi * Math.cos(currentTheta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(target);
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    renderer.setAnimationLoop(animate);
  </script>
</body>
